__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: InfluxDB 2 datasource (Flux) that holds the collector's bucket

__inputs.name: VAR_DOSING_DEVICE
__inputs.label: Dosing device id
__inputs.description: Hubitat device id of the WaterGuru Dosing Advisor tile (WG_DOSING_DEVICE_ID). Leave empty without the dosing collector: the chlorine panels stay empty.

panels.title: pH
panels.description: Full-resolution pH from the SmartPod (waterguru_pod). Green 7.4-7.7, acceptable 7.2-7.8 with yellow shoulders, red outside 7.2-7.8.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "waterguru_pod" and r._field == "ph")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "pod_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Free Chlorine (ppm)
panels.description: Full-resolution free chlorine from the SmartPod (waterguru_pod). Interpret FC using the CYA-based comparison panel: optimal FC = 11.5% of CYA and minimum FC = 7.5% of CYA. Fixed ppm health bands are not used.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "waterguru_pod" and r._field == "freeCl")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "pod_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Total Alkalinity (ppm)
panels.description: Total alkalinity from the lab cassette (waterguru_measure, type TA). Pulled out of the combined Lab balance panel so it isn't flattened by SALT's thousands-scale. Green 80-120 ppm; yellow shoulders; red <60 or >180.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "waterguru_measure" and r._field == "value" and r.type == "TA")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "type"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Flow (gpm)
panels.description: Computed skimmer flow (waterguru_measure, SKIMMER_FLOW). Green ≥6 gpm; yellow 1-6; red 0 (no circulation). For the raw flow signal see waterguru_pod.flowTempDeltaFahr.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "waterguru_measure" and r._field == "value" and r.type == "SKIMMER_FLOW")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "type"])

panels.title: Water Temperature (°F)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")

panels.title: Lab balance (CH / CYA / SALT)
panels.description: Lab-cassette derived values (CH / CYA / SALT) from waterguru_measure. Total Alkalinity now has its own panel above. Note the differing scales (SALT is ppm in the thousands).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")

panels.title: Free Chlorine vs CYA-based optimal (ppm)
panels.description: Actual SmartPod free chlorine vs the CYA-appropriate FC band. Optimal = 11.5% x CYA and Min = 7.5% x CYA (Trouble-Free-Pool FC/CYA rule); WaterGuru target is the app's own CYA-adjusted goal. CYA is a sparse lab-cassette reading, so the reference lines are flat at the latest CYA and step when a new lab result arrives.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "waterguru_pod" and r._field == "freeCl")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "pod_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

import "array"
cya = (from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "waterguru_measure" and r.type == "CYA" and r._field == "value")
  |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value"))[0]
array.from(rows: [
  {_time: v.timeRangeStart, _value: cya * 0.115},
  {_time: v.timeRangeStop, _value: cya * 0.115},
])

import "array"
cya = (from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "waterguru_measure" and r.type == "CYA" and r._field == "value")
  |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value"))[0]
array.from(rows: [
  {_time: v.timeRangeStart, _value: cya * 0.075},
  {_time: v.timeRangeStop, _value: cya * 0.075},
])

import "array"
tgt = (from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "waterguru_measure" and r.type == "FREE_CL" and r._field == "target")

array.from(rows: [

  {_time: v.timeRangeStop, _value: tgt},
])

options.content:
**Totals cover recorded pump-commanded volume only**, in US gallons. Manual additions and missing history are excluded; tank inventory is estimated.

Month/year totals use the Pacific calendar. Missing records stay blank. Check **Tank data age** before relying on inventory. Calendar bars may include a partial final period. The two Recorded stats always run to now, while the calendar bars stop at the end of the selected time range, so the two disagree when that range ends in the past.

panels.title: Recorded this month
panels.description: Estimated commanded volume from the start of this Pacific calendar month to now. The dashboard time picker does not change this total.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Los_Angeles")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1mo), stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_dose" and r._field == "volume_ml")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value >= 0)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> toFloat()
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value / 3785.411784}))

panels.title: Recorded this year
panels.description: Estimated commanded volume from January 1 in America/Los_Angeles to now. Earlier unrecorded doses are not included. The dashboard time picker does not change this total.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Los_Angeles")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1y), stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_dose" and r._field == "volume_ml")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value >= 0)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> toFloat()
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value / 3785.411784}))

panels.title: Tank remaining
panels.description: Latest estimated inventory within 90 days. Check Tank data age before relying on this value.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -90d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_tank" and r._field == "remaining_ml")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value) / 3785.411784}))

panels.title: Tank remaining (%)
panels.description: Latest estimated percentage. Red below 20%, orange from 20% to 30%, green at 30% or more. Check Tank data age.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -90d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_tank" and r._field == "remaining_percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Tank runway to low level
panels.description: Latest app estimate until its configured low-inventory threshold. No estimate is shown before the app has learned a consumption rate.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -90d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_tank" and r._field == "runway_days")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Tank data age
panels.description: Elapsed time since the most recent remaining-volume snapshot. Orange after 48 hours and red after 72 hours for the daily collector.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -90d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_tank" and r._field == "remaining_ml")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

panels.title: Chlorine per recorded dose
panels.description: Estimated liquid volume of each commanded pump run at its recorded dose timestamp. Repeated collection must not create extra dose events.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_dose" and r._field == "volume_ml")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value >= 0)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> toFloat()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Tank inventory and full capacity
panels.description: Estimated remaining volume and configured full capacity at each collected snapshot. Refilling the tank changes inventory, not cumulative usage.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_tank" and (r._field == "remaining_ml" or r._field == "capacity_ml"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Recorded usage by month
panels.description: Pacific calendar month totals, including the complete first month of the selected range. The last month ends at the selected end time. Missing months are not filled with zero.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Los_Angeles")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1mo), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_dose" and r._field == "volume_ml")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value >= 0)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> toFloat()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Period: string(v: date.year(t: r._time)) + "-" + (if date.month(t: r._time) < 10 then "0" else "") + string(v: date.month(t: r._time)), "US gallons": r._value / 3785.411784}))

panels.description: Pacific calendar year totals, including the complete first year of the selected range. The last year ends at the selected end time. Missing years are not filled with zero.

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Period: string(v: date.year(t: r._time)), "US gallons": r._value / 3785.411784}))

panels.title: Free chlorine vs advisor target (ppm)
panels.description: The dosing advisor's own FC target (CYA-aware, or a manual override) beside the reading it was computed from. WaterGuru targets a flat ~3 ppm regardless of stabilizer, which is too low for a stabilized or recovering pool, so these lines can legitimately disagree.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_target")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "measured_ppm" or r._field == "target_ppm")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value >= 0)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> toFloat()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Dose vs commanded pump runtime
panels.description: Volume and the pump runtime it was derived from, on separate axes (mL left, seconds right). Volume is runtime x the configured delivery rate, so a drift between the two means the configured rate no longer matches the pump.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_dose" and r._field == "volume_ml")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value >= 0)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> toFloat()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chlorine_dose" and r._field == "runtime_seconds")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${dosing_device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value >= 0)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> toFloat()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
